title: Included Services on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: Grant, Carry-Over and Expiry
content:
An included service on the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is a workshop service still unused in the current term. Included services are granted when the plan starts or renews and consumed by each completed visit.

### Basis

1. The term's included services are granted in full when the plan starts and again at each renewal, granted to the plan rather than to the host. A grant made on that basis adds the whole of the plan's included services for one term.
2. Unused services carry into the next term only on the plans that allow it, and no more than the plan's rollover ceiling carries however many are left.
3. A carried service expires the plan's expiry period in whole calendar days from the day it was granted, and an expired service is not restored on request.
4. A goodwill service may be granted where the network failed to return the vehicle within the plan's turnaround target, and it is granted as its own record so that goodwill and entitlement stay separable.
5. No services are granted while the plan is paused, and a plan resumed mid-term resumes with the services it had rather than a fresh allowance.

### Read as a host would ask it

*What arrives at the start of a term.* The whole of the plan's included services for that term, in one grant, and the same again at each renewal. The grant attaches to the plan on that vehicle.

*What happens to services left over.* On a plan that allows carrying, as many of them carry as the plan's rollover ceiling permits, and no more, however many were left. On a plan that does not allow carrying, none of them carry.

*How long a carried service lasts.* The plan's expiry period, counted in whole calendar days from the day the service was granted. Once that period has run the service is gone and is not put back.

*What a pause does to the allowance.* Nothing is granted while the plan is paused, and when the plan resumes part-way through a term it resumes with the services it had at the pause.

### Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

*A plan that allows carrying, whose rollover ceiling is 2 and whose term includes 5 services.* The term opens with a grant of 5. Three are consumed by completed visits and two remain at the end of the term. The ceiling of 2 is not below the two left, so both carry into the next term, alongside the fresh grant of 5 the new term brings. Had four remained instead, only 2 would have carried. These figures are hypothetical and illustrate the basis only; each plan sets its own included services and its own rollover ceiling.
